_about: Public-domain Edwin Hubbell Chapin (1814-1880), Universalist minister of the Church of the Divine Paternity, New York, for the Word Hoard: Duties of Young Men (1840), Discourses on Various Subjects (1841), Duties of Young Women (1848), Hours of Communion (1848), Discourses on the Lord's Prayer (1850), Characters in the Gospels (1852), Discourses on the Beatitudes (1853), Moral Aspects of City Life (1853) and Christianity the Perfection of True Manliness (1856). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 64 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

chapin-young-men: Duties of young men, exhibited in six lectures; with an Anniversary address, delivered before the Richmond Lyceum (Boston, A. Tompkins, and B. B. Mussey, 1840)
chapin-lords-prayer: Discourses on the Lord's Prayer (Boston, A. Tompkins, 1850)

chapin-true-manliness: Christianity the perfection of true manliness (New York : H. Lyon, 1856)

_excluded.chapin-other: Hymns for Christian Devotion (1846, with J. G. Adams) and The Fountain (a temperance annual he co-edited); Universalist collections by several hands
